description: Mandate acknowledgment (opt-in, DCP-09 3.3): the activation of a delegation evaluated over the delegated admission. Expected outcomes are written from the rules; the codes are an ordered list (design 7.2); messages are not compared.

cases.name: depth_one
cases.rule: design 4: every mandate acknowledged by its agent

cases.name: depth_two_any_order
cases.rule: design 4: acknowledgments and thresholds in any order

cases.name: acknowledged_before_valid_from
cases.rule: design 6: an acknowledgment may precede valid_from

cases.name: pq_only
cases.rule: design 5: pq_only applies the policy as F2

cases.name: pq_only_classical_advisory
cases.rule: design 5: pq_only skips the classical policy, as F2

cases.name: weak_classical_policy
cases.rule: design 5: a classical_only policy does not lower the acknowledgment contract

cases.name: slh_acknowledgment
cases.rule: design 5: ed25519 + slh-dsa-192f on the acknowledgment

cases.name: slh_threshold
cases.rule: design 5: ed25519 + slh-dsa-192f on the threshold

cases.name: t1_t2_equal
cases.rule: design 6: acknowledged_at equal to the mandate and threshold timestamps

cases.name: t4_equal
cases.rule: design 6: acknowledged_at equal to now plus 30 s

cases.name: t5_equal
cases.rule: design 6: the parent acknowledgment at the sub-mandate timestamp

cases.name: integral_float
cases.rule: design 2.1: 4242.0 has an integer value (written as 4242.0)

cases.name: value_one
cases.rule: design 2.2: the host value 1 (its long-mantissa Go bytes are in go_bytes_cases)

cases.name: threshold_reused
cases.rule: design 7.2 cardinality 6: one threshold per acknowledgment, within a call

cases.name: mandate_id_not_in_chain
cases.rule: design 4.4: mandate_id is the matching key

cases.name: mandate_hash_with_signature
cases.rule: design 2: the hash excludes the signature fields

cases.name: classical_component_altered
cases.rule: design 4.2 C: the PQ component covers the classical one

cases.name: classical_invalid_pq_resigned
cases.rule: design 5: the classical component is verified

cases.name: classical_invalid_pq_resigned_pq_only
cases.rule: design 5: the classical component is verified under pq_only too

cases.name: pq_null
cases.rule: design 2: the form requires a PQ component

cases.name: root_acknowledged_by_sub
cases.rule: design 4.2 B: only the mandate agent's passport

cases.name: classical_names_pq_key
cases.rule: design 4.2 B: a key of another algorithm

cases.name: t5_parent_after_child
cases.rule: design 6 T5, attributed to the parent

cases.name: agent_revoked
cases.rule: design 4.3: the composition is not admitted

cases.name: rejected_composition_malformed_acknowledgment
cases.rule: design 4.3: no ACK_ code when not evaluated

cases.name: nonce_and_chain
cases.rule: design 7.2: every failed check, in order

go_bytes_cases.name: long_mantissa_value_one

parser_matches_canonical.rule: json.Unmarshal of go_text reproduces the canonical bytes of the exact value: the base case

parser_differs_or_fails.rule: json.Unmarshal of go_text differs from those canonical bytes or fails: a local parser fault (design 2.2)

go_bytes_cases.port_requirement: Go decodes go_text with its real parser, compares CanonicalizeV2 of that value with the expected canonical bytes, and applies the expectation that condition selects; a private test decoder that alters the value exercises parser_differs_or_fails whatever the runtime does. Accepting either outcome without checking the condition is not allowed.
go_bytes_cases.runtime_observation: docs/reviews/go-long-number-independent-results.json: go1.26.0 decodes this literal as 0. An observation of that runtime, not a requirement for later ones.
